# Sleek Mobile App Design Skill for Muse

💳 **Paid API required.** Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT) by @designed-by-ai, listed here with credit to its creator. Connects Muse to the Sleek AI mobile-app design tool via its REST API: create projects, describe what you want in plain language, and get back rendered screens — with live streaming in the Sleek editor, screenshot capture (viewport and full-height), and implementation guidance for HTML prototypes, React Native, and SwiftUI (icon sets, fonts, navigation). The skill documents the full API contract (projects, components, chat runs, screenshots, references) and sensible workflows: style directions authored per variation, pinned versions, polling, and idempotency. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the Sleek service is paid — new accounts get roughly one design run of trial credits; sustained use needs the Pro plan (stated in the skill as $49.99/month or $360/year for ~650 screens). Requires a SLEEK_API_KEY stored in your secure vault, never pasted raw. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
